messages:
Sam: FYI ACME (ticket #12345) reporting p95/p99 spike since ~08:24 UTC after the config rollout. p95 went from ~400ms -> 1.6s, p99 from ~2.8s -> ~8.2s. Mostly small prompts (<=8 tokens).
Priya: Looking. Any repro snippets or obvious errors in logs? Are we seeing 5xxs or timeouts? Link to their dashboard? :eyes:
Oliver: Customer sent sample request + timing CSV. No 5xxs, just large tail latency. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/tenants/acme-01/requests?from=08:00&to=09:00
Luca: I rolled out the affinity batcher change in release v2026.03.17 at 07:50 UTC. The new defaults increased hold_window for small requests to 3000ms to try to improve batching efficiency. Config snippet pushed: 
```
batcher:
  policy: affinity
  hold_window_ms: 3000
  max_batch_size: 64
  small_request_threshold_tokens: 16
```
Nina: Correlating logs — acme-01 shows queueing patterns that match: lots of tiny prompts enqueued, waited full hold window, then batched together. Sample log lines: 
```
[continuous-batcher] tenant=acme-01 enqueue=0.0001s wait=3.002s batch_size=18 tokens=7 request_id=tx-9e3
[continuous-batcher] tenant=acme-01 enqueue=0.0002s wait=3.001s batch_size=18 tokens=6 request_id=tx-9e4
```
Nina: Because affinity groups by tenant, when the last request in a group arrives it forces the whole group to wait the full hold_window -> long tail for the earliest request. Small prompt ratio for this tenant is ~78% which amplifies the effect.
Sam: Repro steps from customer (they used curl): 
```bash
for i in {1..20}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"Hi"}' &
  sleep 0.05
done
wait
```
Sam: That sequence reliably reproduces the tail at our side when affinity hold_window=3000ms.
Priya: Proposed hotfix: revert hold_window_ms back to previous ~800ms on canary and enable small_request_flush feature for tenant acme-01 so tiny inputs are flushed early. Any objections?
Luca: Agree. Will prepare a rollback to canary and add feature flag targeting acme-01.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback-batcher-affinity-2026-03-17 -> canary (initiated by Luca)
Priya: Rolling back on canary now. Monitoring p95/p99.
(5m later) Priya: Canary metrics: p99 for acme-01 dropped from ~8.2s -> ~520ms, p95 back to ~450ms. No error increase. Rolling to 20%. :thumbsup:
Nina: Root cause summary: affinity grouping + increased hold_window for small_request_threshold mismatch. For tenants with very high small-prompt ratios the variance of arrival times creates long tail when groups wait for last member.
Nina: Short-term mitigations: revert hold_window default to 800ms, enable per-tenant small_request_flush flag, add telemetry to flag high small-prompt-ratio tenants. Long-term: adapt hold_window based on observed inter-arrival distribution per-tenant and add a max-wait percentile cap.
Oliver: Customer updated and confirmed latency improved after the canary rollback. They're happy and want timeline for permanent fix.
Sam: Action items: (1) Luca to push config default revert + feature flag gating (2) Nina to add small-prompt telemetry and a dashboard row (3) Priya to monitor rollout to 100% and keep support loop open with ACME.
Luca: Will open PR for config revert + feature flag, target merge in 2h.
Priya: Thanks team — keeping this thread for follow-ups. I'll post final rollout completion here. :white_check_mark:
